description:
Found while reviewing fz-sc8.3. src/compiler2/frontdoor.rs threads a module_path: &[String] parameter through parse_item, parse_module, parse_struct_item, parse_expr and the rest (about 25 signatures). Its only use is parse_module extending it into nested_path and passing that on; grep finds no site that reads the path for a decision or a value. Verified by grep on 2053b04a5, not by removing it.

Done when: the parameter is renamed with a leading underscore to let cargo check enumerate real readers; if there are none, the parameter and nested_path are deleted from every signature. A pure removal: no fixture or pin moves.
title: The source parser threads no module path it never reads
